selection: Select the exact asset ID and original source model SHA. A texture-compressed runtime GLB may have a different file SHA. Pass sourceSHA256 plus rigContract from rig-contracts.json; the adapter checks actual local rest/hierarchy, skin bindMatrix and every inverseBindMatrix. Call before posing the skeleton. Files already contain that target's bind/rest proportions; do not retarget again.

runtimeBindingOptions.sourceSHA256: exact original rig SHA recorded in catalog
runtimeBindingOptions.targetSHA256: actual optimized runtime GLB SHA, if available

sharedAuthorship: One CH-LU pair of supplier idle/run tasks, one pre-existing walk, and one shared deterministic tactical pose program. Target-specific GLBs are local fixed-length/contact adaptations, never new provider tasks.

bones.lengths: All local bone links fixed at each target's rest length except animated Hip position; Root remains fixed.
bones.twists: All twist bones retained; branch twist bones inherit parent swing/roll. Neck twist bones are explicitly articulated.

root.vertical: Root fixed; crouch descent exists once in Hip
root.controller: Collider/camera may change from 1.8 m to 1.18 m, but model floor origin stays fixed. Never lower the entire model by the capsule height difference.
root.findCover: AI/controller selects cover and moves the character; clips do not navigate or translate to cover.

transitions.oneShot: LoopOnce; clampWhenFinished=true; crossfade at state boundaries
transitions.startEndContracts: See catalog.clips start/end labels. ready→crouch_down→crouch_idle→stand_up→ready and ready→cover_enter→cover_idle→cover_exit→ready match endpoint poses.
transitions.aim: Crossfade cover_idle to side-specific cover_aim. cover_fire starts and ends in that same aim pose. cover_peek makes a complete look-out-and-return excursion.

weapon.origin: Measured pistol-grip center coincides with R_Hand world origin
weapon.support: Measured lower handguard center coincides with L_Hand world origin
weapon.attachmentPosition: -sourceGrip rotated by attachmentQuaternion and multiplied by attachmentScale
weapon.outerScale: Do not apply the old 0.68 weapon-parent scale again. The character's sourceToMeters already provides physical scale.
weapon.axes: Rifle source -Z is rotated to character +X; actual front/rear sights are made collinear. The character holder -π/2 yaw maps +X to game +Z.
weapon.recoil: Pose only; projectile, muzzle flash, sound, aim target and AI timing remain controller responsibilities.
weapon.eyeContact: Head-forward and sight-forward directions are measured in the validation report. Exact face/eye alignment, cheek weld, stock/shoulder collision and first-person ADS are not certified by this numerical asset check.

contact.stationaryAuthored: Both foot/toe-weighted sole bounds solved onto each original rest floor; sub-frame interpolation residuals are reported.
contact.crouchWalk: Alternating stance and swing. In-place foot travel requires controller speed/phase matching; this is not a world-locked foot implementation.
contact.supplierLocomotion: Original motion retained with target link constraints and floor penetration correction. Run can have an airborne phase. No claim that both feet must remain down while running.

child.armedPoses: Technical candidates only. Short arms require substantially larger rearward rifle placement; child AK shoulder/body contact is NOT approved. Keep child combat disabled until explicitly reviewed.
child.height: 1.25 m is the explicit technical preview calibration, not a claim about final narrative/game height.

knownRisks: CH-SHAO and CH-DOCTOR retain their known local weight/cloth issues.
Follow-up dense edge audit found SHAO connected coat/hip edge 10723-10736 stretches 6.04mm to 67.12mm (11.114x at 1.8m scale), not a zero-length artifact.
LU and DOCTOR left shoulder/chest edges, and ZHOU left rib edge with a thigh-bone influence, also show material localized stretching.
These are usable inspection/integration candidates, not generally approved shared motions. Visual skin/cloth acceptance is pending.
